item.title: Bring more wearable history into Murph
item.summary: Connected wearables can now bring up to six months of supported low-frequency history, including AFib burden, VO2 max, temperature, breathing disturbance, recovery, hydration, caffeine, and mindfulness.
item.details: Dense streams stay bounded to recent data, and the longer import runs in the existing background sync only for data the connected source says it provides.
